why: A call of a name MATLAB has only as a method of its classes (`parse` of an inputParser, `keys` of a dictionary) that no project symbol carries is a call leaving the index, kept dormant; a project parse.m added links it and removed puts it back to sleep; a sync ends where a fresh index does (project rule; harvested from matlab-dormant.test.ts 'a name MATLAB has only as a method of one of its classes').
